sources.excerpt: Official Chaplin's homepage identifies the operating restaurant, kitchen hours, phone 202-644-8806, and links its location-specific Toast ordering surface.
Official current food menu lists Mazemen, Ramen, Crowd Pleasers, Curry Rice Bowls, Hot and Cold Impressions, Drunken Masters, and Dessert with ingredient descriptions and dietary options.
Official drinks page lists current Low to No, Empty Promises, and Tea offerings; alcoholic sections were excluded.
Official brunch page describes a weekend bottomless-bubbles beverage package but no separate food products; alcohol-only offerings are out of scope.
Restaurant-linked Toast surface identifies Chaplin's DC at 1501 9th Street Northwest and exposes current Food Menu and Non-Alcoholic & Teas products.
Inspected official homepage, food menu, drinks, brunch, and navigation. Ingredient and dietary descriptions exist, but no comprehensive allergen matrix or cross-contact statement was found.
Inspected official-domain sitemap and allergen, allergy, nutrition, ingredient, FAQ, PDF, image, CDN, and downloadable-document surfaces; no official matrix was found.
Inspected all restaurant-linked Toast food and nonalcoholic sections and item descriptions; no comprehensive allergen matrix or cross-contact disclosure was present.
Targeted official-domain and Chaplin's DC Shaw searches returned current menu pages but no comprehensive restaurant-issued allergen matrix.
